ModMetaData.name: SillyAnimalThings
ModMetaData.author: Ordoxous
ModMetaData.description:
Gives animals silly abilities, using the same special-training system as Odyssey's war trumpet. Wild and hostile animals use most of them on their own; tamed animals use them once trained.
- Elephant, mastodon: trunk blast (a water spray that knocks enemies back, staggers them and puts out fires) and trunk throw (picks up a nearby rock chunk and launches it) - Boomalope, boomrat, toxalope: detonate (runs at a target and blows itself up) - Alphabeaver: gnaw (chews through wooden structures and eats them; hungry wild alphabeavers will snack on your buildings) - Boomrat, lava snail: fire burst (sprays burning fuel around itself, requires Biotech) - Penguin, otter, seal, sea lion: belly slide (a fast dash along the ground) - Walrus, rhinoceros, hippo, bison, muffalo, wild boar, ibex, goat, moose, elk, mastodon, elephant: charge (barrels into a target, battering and knocking back nearby enemies) - Wolverine, badger: regenerate (a burst of rapid healing, used automatically when badly hurt) - Tiger, cougar, panther, scimitar cat: hidden dragon (turns invisible until it strikes, used automatically before closing in)
